ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a dominant high-intensity white field with sparse low-intensity mottling. The central fluke junction and the interior section of the right lobe are characterized by a dense, low-intensity black contiguous block. The right distal tip returns to high-intensity white with localized low-intensity terminal clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3-15 pixels. Notable deep indentations are localized on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep with a moderately convex curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, rounded tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters at the terminal edge of the right lobe and scattered individual low-intensity spots across the left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, horizontally aligned low-intensity linear marks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, breaking the high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serration patterns and deep notches on the right lobe trailing edge suggest historical tissue loss or significant abrasive contact.
other_distinctive_markers: The sharp contrast boundary between the dark central region and the white left lobe forms a distinct vertical demarcation line.
